source.note: Salesloft publishes one compressed OpenAPI operation fragment per content-hashed reference chunk. The build-time api-spec/v2/v2.json is not served. This fixture stores derived route contracts and hashes, not a rehosted vendor specification.

repaired_compatibility_arguments.cadence_membership_create: person_id, cadence_id, user_id, step_id, and task_id are official query parameters, not JSON body fields
repaired_compatibility_arguments.note_association: note list/create use associated_with_type and associated_with_id; person_id/account_id/user_id were not documented fields
repaired_compatibility_arguments.collection_filters: array-shaped official filters are exposed as arrays and every caller-controlled query key uses the query. runtime prefix

source_decision.reason: No live Salesloft connection was available for the empirical field-presence proof required by the authoring guide, and the public site does not expose one monolithic document that the Source contract can pin.

auth.selected: Bearer token supplied only by the enrolled Salesloft connection
